decisions.reason: The source requires preservation and restoration of the established VvÉ proportions but does not change the selected 2% endpoint-height calibration or alignment rules.
Restoring the lost Hero V is execution evidence rather than a change to its required master geometry; the new terminal treatment is owned by the separate shared-terminal Requirement.
The necessary proportional transfer of the finalized Hero V terminal to the second V is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY at message 202.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY that establishes the softer non-calligraphic treatment, application order, and removal of obsolete height-study terminal constraints.
The source prioritizes restoration of the VvÉ foundation but does not change the required construction, proportions, or architectural language of the remaining letterforms.
The source preserves the established VvÉ hierarchy and does not alter the selected kerning, baseline, cap-height hierarchy, or complete-wordmark composition rules.
The terminal and hierarchy correction does not change the selected champagne-gold finish, distribution, or material-treatment requirements.
A softer but non-calligraphic terminal remains compatible with the existing brand-expression constraints and does not revise the broader identity positioning or visual-tone requirements.
The source does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
The source concerns VvÉ geometry and terminal treatment and has no effect on the production-ready asset-delivery obligation.
